001: Ivan, could you tell me where a good grocery store is around here?
There's a supermarket not far away, about five minutes on foot.
And does it stay open late?
Yes, until eleven in the evening.
Great, then I'll go there after work.
If you want, we can go together.
002: I need to buy a gift for my mom, but I have no idea what to choose.
What does she like? Maybe books or cosmetics?
She likes to read, but she already has a lot of books.
Then you could give her a nice scarf or a bag.
That's a good idea, thanks for the advice.
You're welcome, I'll help you choose if you want.
003: Dmitry, have you seen where they sell good sneakers?
There's a sports store in the mall on the corner.
And do they have discounts there?
There was a sale last week, but now, probably not anymore.
Too bad, then I'll look online.
Online they're often cheaper, but you need to check the size.
004: I want to buy a new coat for winter, but I don't know which color to choose.
Dark blue or gray suits you.
Really? And I was thinking about black.
Black is also good, but blue will be fresher.
Then I'll go to the store and try on both options.
Good idea, the main thing is that you feel comfortable.
005: Sergey, do you know where I can buy fresh vegetables?
At the market around the corner there's always a good selection.
And are the prices there reasonable?
Yes, even cheaper than at the supermarket.
Then I'll go there on Saturday morning.
It's better to come earlier, while everything is the freshest.
006: I need to buy a new laptop bag, mine is already torn.
At the electronics store there's a good selection.
There are different options, from inexpensive to very expensive.
I need one that's not too expensive, but good quality.
Then look at leather ones, they last longer.
007: Olga, could you tell me where I can buy flowers?
Across the street there's a flower shop, it's open until eight.
And what flowers are best to give a friend for her birthday?
Roses or tulips — that's always a good choice.
Then I'll buy white roses, she loves them.
Great idea, white roses are very beautiful.
008: I want to buy new headphones, but I don't know which ones are better.
I want to keep it within three thousand rubles.
For that money you can find good wireless headphones.
And where is it better to buy them, in a store or online?
Better in a store, so you can check the sound.
009: Dmitry, do you know where they sell good coffee beans?
At the coffee shop on the embankment there's an excellent selection.
And do they sell coffee to go?
Yes, you can buy a bag and take it with you.
Then I'll stop by there after lunch.
Try their Brazilian coffee, it's very tasty.
010: I need to buy a new shirt for work, but I don't know what size to get.
And what size do you usually wear?
Usually a forty-eight, but sometimes it varies.
Then it's better to try it on before buying.
Yes, you're right, I'll go to the store and try it on.
If anything, you can order a different size online.
